# Vdevice SDK

Unmodified `Vdevice.h`, `Vdevice.cpp` and `LICENSE` from
https://github.com/TitanCSA/Vdevice at release `v1.0.5.0-demo`, commit
`4eb018655d432296dd5a23e8da6784c3217ae3ab`.

The SDK source is MIT licensed. No vendor driver binary is included.
`MouseProtocol.h` adapts the USB/HID descriptors in that release's
`ExamplesUI/Mouse.cpp` under the same license (Copyright 2026 TitanCSA).
The driver is obtained and licensed separately from the vendor.
